URL: https://www.iea.org/reports/oil-market-report-november-2026
(Search snippet content — full article 403'd on direct fetch; IEA's own reporting language)

"World oil demand is forecast to fall by 2.7 mb/d in 2026, to 102.3 mb/d, before rebounding by 2 mb/d in 2027."

"global oil supply rose by a further 2.3 mb/d to 105.4 mb/d in October on lofty Gulf exports despite ongoing attacks on energy infrastructure and tankers."

"Gulf oil exports, excluding Oman, reached 18.4 mb/d last month, 26% below pre-war levels."

"Our November supply and demand balances suggest that the global oil market will return to a surplus in 4Q26, with a more substantial build in 2027."
